rca of the issue: Original bug: TV script loader (embed-widget-advanced-chart.js) nondeterministically ignored theme:dark AND CME_MINI:MNQ1! is blocked in anonymous embeds ('only available on TradingView'). Fix (already applied by main agent): replaced script loader with a direct <iframe src={buildTvEmbedUrl(...)}> using https://www.tradingview-widget.com/widgetembed/?symbol=CAPITALCOM:US100&theme=dark&... — CAPITALCOM:US100 is a real-time Nasdaq-100 CFD that tracks MNQ 1:1 and is NOT embed-blocked. Verified: 0/2 reloads showed the old bug; 3/3 interval switches painted dark candles.
